questions.question: How would you design a low-latency vector search service querying over 100 million embeddings?
key_points_to_cover: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) indexing: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) or IVF (Inverted File Index)
Vector quantization: Product Quantization (PQ) or Scalar Quantization to compress vectors in memory
Horizontal sharding across distributed vector nodes
Caching layer: In-memory LRU or Redis for frequent queries
Two-stage retrieval: Fast ANN coarse retrieval followed by precision re-ranking on top candidates

questions.question: How do you handle API rate limits and high latency when integrating external LLMs into user-facing production systems?
key_points_to_cover: Token bucket / Leaky bucket rate limiting algorithms
Exponential backoff with jitter on HTTP 429 errors
Semantic caching for repeated or similar queries
Asynchronous task queues (Celery, Redis Queue, RabbitMQ) for batch jobs
Streaming chunked responses via Server-Sent Events (SSE) to reduce perceived Time-To-First-Token (TTFT)
